props.text: ▶ EARLY ACCESS · Q1 2027 · STEAM · WINDOWS / MAC / LINUX
Survive the orchids. Steal the seed.

Vault & Vine is a roguelike heist sim about three burglars, one impossibly valuable plant, and a Victorian glasshouse that does not want them to leave. Plan the route. Pick the locks. Pacify the carnivorous philodendron. Get out before the orchids wake up. Then start the next run, because they will.

content.heading: ▶ SCREENSHOTS
content.subheading: Six frames from the current build. Pixel-art at 360p, upscaled to 1080p with a custom CRT shader. Yes you can turn the shader off.

props.title: PROCEDURAL HEIST PLANNING
props.description: Every greenhouse layout is generated fresh. Forty-three room types, eleven trap categories, and a vine-growth simulation that means the route you scouted on run twelve is gone by run thirteen. Plan in chalk, not in stone.

props.title: BOTANICAL ENEMY AI
props.description: Twenty-eight plant species, each with its own pollen radius, pacification verb, and grudge state. The orchids remember which burglar pruned them last run. Some plants can be bribed. Most cannot.

props.title: FIVE LOCKPICK MINI-GAMES
props.description: Tumbler, magnetic, Victorian-mortice, biological-keyed, and the dread Goldsmith's puzzle. Each has its own rhythm. The biological-keyed locks open faster if you've eaten the right pollen. We are not joking.

props.title: THREE PLAYABLE BURGLARS
props.description: Pim, the lockpick. Yusra, the climber. Old Man Halvorsen, who used to own the greenhouse and has Opinions. Each has 14 unlockable perks, three signature tools, and one canonical regret.

props.title: MORALITY-AGNOSTIC ENDINGS
props.description: Eleven possible endings. The greenhouse does not forgive you, but it might let you leave. The seed is the seed regardless. Two of the endings are not in any guide on the internet, because we have not shipped yet.

props.title: ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK · 41 TRACKS
props.description: Composed by Inês Ramalho on a 1976 Korg PS-3300 we found at a flea market in Matosinhos. Adaptive — the orchid section gets weirder when they wake up. Soundtrack ships free with the game.

content.heading: ▶ WHAT'S IN THE GAME
content.subheading: Six pillars. Each one playable in the current build. Each one will be sharpened in early access. None of them are placeholder.

props.name: Inês Ramalho
props.bio: Trained at Conservatório de Música do Porto. Owns four synthesizers older than she is. The orchid theme has been rewritten eleven times. She says it is now correct. We believe her.

props.name: Diogo Salgueiro
props.bio: Wrote the vine-growth simulation in three weekends, then spent eight months making it look like it grows in real-time. Will argue with you about deterministic seed-based RNG until your beer is warm.

props.name: Mariana Costa
props.bio: Pixel-art at 16x16 sprites with a 32-color palette per scene. Drew Old Man Halvorsen from a photograph of her grandfather. The orchids are not based on anyone in particular. Probably.

props.name: Fluffy
props.bio: Joined the studio in February 2024 as a six-week-old tabby found behind the bakery downstairs. Has stepped on the keyboard during exactly two production builds. Both shipped.

content.heading: ▶ WHO MAKES THIS
content.subheading: Three humans, one cat, one shared kitchen in Porto. We have known each other for eight years. We do not have a publisher and are not looking for one.

props.quote: Played the demo at LudoNarraCon and immediately rebooked my flight to stay another day so I could play it again. The orchid sequence in particular is doing something genuinely new with environmental enemy AI.
props.author: Astrid Mehlhase
props.role: Senior Editor · Rock Paper Shotgun · LudoNarraCon 2025 coverage

props.quote: Vault & Vine is one of three indie titles I'm watching for 2027. The vibe is Hades-meets-Thief with a botanical-horror twist, but the hook is the procedural greenhouse — every run scouts a layout you've never seen.
props.author: Jordan Akamine

props.text: We don't have a marketing budget. We have three people, one cat, and a Steam page. If you wishlist Vault & Vine before launch, the Steam algorithm shows it to seven other people who might wishlist it. That math is the whole strategy. Thank you in advance — sincerely, all four of us.
